intro: Wizzlecrank's Shredder is a Venture Company shredder stuck in the foul depths of Sludge Fen in the northern Barrens. The goblin Pilot Wizzlecrank has climbed inside to steal it, but without its key the machine will not move, and it sits amidst hostile Venture Company operators. Helping fire up its engine is the only way the trapped pilot can make a desperate bid for freedom.

p: Deep within the oil-slicked, heavily polluted basin of Sludge Fen sits Wizzlecrank's Shredder, immobile and surrounded by hostile Venture Company mercenaries. The goblin inside, Wizzlecrank, hopped into the Venture Co. machine to steal it, only to discover he needed a key to unlock its movement column. When another shredder operator asked if everything was all right, he panicked and blamed a mechanical problem. Now he sits sealed inside amid hostile guards and overseers, hoping someone can fetch the key before the Venture Company grows suspicious.
